title: Convenience store with fuel sales, 6 employees — Toa Baja

expected.name: Ask whether a new/altered exterior sign is planned; require the applicable sign permit only if triggered.
Do not assume a lease. Ask ownership/tenure and request lease only if leased; otherwise request deed/other occupancy evidence.
Certificate of Organization (Puerto Rico LLC formation document)
DACO weights-and-measures registration/inspection for fuel dispensers
Retail Cigarette License (Licencia de Detallista de Cigarrillos)
Background Check Documentation (Certificado de Antecedentes Penales)
Tobacco Sales Projection (Proyección de Ventas de Tabaco)

amendments.change: Added DOC_TOBACCO_RETAIL_LICENSE + its four Hacienda prerequisites (ASUME, CRIM, Certificado de Antecedentes Penales, Proyección o Volumen de Ventas) as required.
amendments.why: This scenario answers Q_TOBACCO_SOLD=true, but when it was validated (2026-09-16) Q_TOBACCO_SOLD was orphaned (zero rules), so the reviewed set could not contain the cigarette license. REG-TOBACCO-RETAIL-001 (RULE_0701-0705, 2026-09-28) closed that false negative. Hacienda's official 'Requisitos para cada tipo de Licencia de Rentas Internas' page lists, for the Licencia de Detallista / Mayorista de Cigarrillos: SC 2309, ASUME, CRIM negative-debt certification, Proyección o Volumen de Ventas and Certificado de Antecedentes Penales, with no exception (unlike the alcohol retail license, whose sales projection 'no aplica a las licencias de tiempo limitado' and is therefore needs_more_information in G01/G03). Mirrors the validated alcohol pattern in G01/G03 (license + ASUME + CRIM + background check required).
